title: Conflict erupts in Khartoum
description: Fighting breaks out between the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF) and the Rapid Support Forces (RSF) in Khartoum and other cities, triggering the displacement crisis.

title: First mass cross-border outflows
description: Within days, tens of thousands cross into Chad, Egypt, South Sudan, Ethiopia and CAR. UNHCR begins emergency border monitoring at Adre, Qustul, Joda and Metema.

title: On 24 April, US Secretary of State Antony Blinken announced that the warring factions in S...
description: On 24 April, US Secretary of State Antony Blinken announced that the warring factions in Sudan had agreed to a ceasefire, “starting at midnight on 24 April, to last for 72 hours.”

title: The UN welcomed the 72-hour ceasefire, brokered by the United States, and calls on the par...
description: The UN welcomed the 72-hour ceasefire, brokered by the United States, and calls on the parties to pursue a permanent end to the fighting.

title: “Health facilities and hospitals should be safe havens in times of crisis,” the UN Populat...
description: “Health facilities and hospitals should be safe havens in times of crisis,” the UN Population Fund (UNFPA) said on 6 May, condemning an attack on a hospital in Khartoum.

title: Jeddah Declaration
description: SAF and RSF sign the Jeddah Declaration of Commitment to Protect the Civilians of Sudan; fighting nonetheless continues.

title: The facilitators stated that they were highly concerned with significant violations of the...
description: The facilitators stated that they were highly concerned with significant violations of the ceasefire.

title: El Geneina violence peaks
description: Ethnically targeted violence in El Geneina, West Darfur, including the killing of the state governor, drives one of the largest single outflows of the crisis into Chad via Adre.

title: An Ethiopian returnee tested positive for cholera at the Metema border, raising concerns t...
description: An Ethiopian returnee tested positive for cholera at the Metema border, raising concerns that the congestion and poor sanitation heighten the risks of a cholera outbreak and other communicable diseases.

title: North Darfur The Ministry of Health reported that there is no cholera outbreak and said it...
description: North Darfur The Ministry of Health reported that there is no cholera outbreak and said it was going to investigate further.

title: Half a million refugees in Chad
description: Chad becomes host to the largest Sudanese refugee outflow; eastern Chad provinces (Ouaddai, Sila, Wadi Fira) absorb hundreds of thousands of mostly women and children.

title: Highlights  As of 27 August, 35,106 refugees and asylum-seekers (16,865 families) have ar...
description: Highlights  As of 27 August, 35,106 refugees and asylum-seekers (16,865 families) have arrived in Ethiopia from Sudan.  Following a relative improvement of the security situation in Amhara, UNHCR has been able to resume its activities in Metema.  A cholera outbreak in the Kumer camp, Amhara region, has claimed three lives.

title: Sudanese authorities have reportedly restricted, and in some cases denied, access to terri...
description: Sudanese authorities have reportedly restricted, and in some cases denied, access to territory at Gallabat entry point due to fears that the cholera outbreak in Ethiopia will spread to Sudan.

title: Resident and Humanitarian Coordinator in Sudan, Clementine Nkweta-Salami also released a s...
description: Resident and Humanitarian Coordinator in Sudan, Clementine Nkweta-Salami also released a statement the same day condemning the attack on a market in southern Khartoum on 10 September, and the ongoing killing of civilians in Khartoum, Nyala, El Fasher, and other areas.

title: Health As part of the response to the outbreak of cholera, partner organizations and refug...
description: Health As part of the response to the outbreak of cholera, partner organizations and refugee representatives in the Kumer site have benefitted from orientation and awareness-raising sessions on prevention methods.

title: At the same event, UN Under-Secretary-General for Political and Peacebuilding Affairs, Ros...
description: At the same event, UN Under-Secretary-General for Political and Peacebuilding Affairs, Rosemary DiCarlo called on the Sudanese national army and Rapid Support Forces to lay down their arms, underscoring that only a return to the negotiating table, “to advance a meaningful ceasefire that would lead to a durable cession of hostilities”, could end the suffering.

title: Highlights ▪ As of 8 October, 37,289 refugees and asylum-seekers (17,639 families), includ...
description: Highlights ▪ As of 8 October, 37,289 refugees and asylum-seekers (17,639 families), including 1,694 Ethiopian refugee returnees, have crossed from Sudan to Ethiopia. ▪ The cholera outbreak in Kumer site has been contained leading to a closure of the cholera treatment center. ▪ 874 vulnerable families received Multi-Purpose Cash Assistance (MPCA) to cover their immediate needs, including food.

title: Sudan becomes world's largest displacement crisis
description: With over 4.5 million IDPs and 1.2 million refugees, Sudan is declared the largest internal displacement crisis in the world.

title: The United Nations Integrated Transition Assistance Mission in Sudan (UNITAMS) also welcom...
description: The United Nations Integrated Transition Assistance Mission in Sudan (UNITAMS) also welcomed the ongoing talks in Jeddah, expressing hope that the new round of negotiations will result in the implementation of the Declaration of Commitment to Protect the Civilians of Sudan, and a comprehensive ceasefire, “which are both crucial to alleviate the suffering of the Sudanese people”.

title: RSF takes most of Darfur capitals
description: RSF captures Nyala, Zalingei and El Geneina garrisons; El Fasher remains the last SAF-held Darfur capital, becoming a refuge for displaced people.

title: Updates by Location Khartoum UNHCR supplied five tents to Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) B...
description: Updates by Location Khartoum UNHCR supplied five tents to Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) Belgium for use as mobile clinics at Al Naw hospital in Omdurman, Khartoum State, supporting their response to the cholera outbreak.

title: In Renk, 3,552 out of 4,646 individuals were biometrically registered while only photos we...
description: In Renk, 3,552 out of 4,646 individuals were biometrically registered while only photos were used for the remaining 1,094 children whose biometrics cannot be captured.

title: On 25 November, the African Union Peace and Security Council (PSC) reaffirmed calls for th...
description: On 25 November, the African Union Peace and Security Council (PSC) reaffirmed calls for the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF) and Rapid Support Forces (RSF) to immediately and unconditionally reach a ceasefire to end the conflict in Sudan.

title: On 4 December, the UN Spokesperson said that humanitarians and partners are scaling up a r...
description: On 4 December, the UN Spokesperson said that humanitarians and partners are scaling up a response to the outbreak of cholera across Sudan.

title: Wad Madani offensive
description: RSF attacks and on 18 December captures Wad Madani, Aj Jazirah state - itself a refuge hosting half a million displaced. Over 300,000 flee again (secondary displacement) toward Gedaref, Kassala and White Nile.

title: Over the past week, since the RSF captured Wad Madani, SAF recruitment increased across Ri...
description: Over the past week, since the RSF captured Wad Madani, SAF recruitment increased across River Nile State.

title: But because of the constant stream of newcomers, this ration was reduced by about 0.9 litr...
description: But because of the constant stream of newcomers, this ration was reduced by about 0.9 litres every day until January 13, at which point it fell to 11.3 litres of water per person per day.

title: Nationwide telecommunications blackout
description: A near-total telecoms blackout cuts millions off from money transfers and family contact for weeks, hampering aid coordination.

title: The Participants all stressed the critical importance of working towards a ceasefire, and ...
description: The Participants all stressed the critical importance of working towards a ceasefire, and expressed the imperative of ensuring coordination of the various mediation initiatives. ▪ On 21 February 2024, the Government of Sudan communicated the suspension of cross-border humanitarian operations from eastern Chad through the Adre border crossing point.

title: UN Security Council Ramadan ceasefire call
description: UNSC resolution 2724 calls for a Ramadan cessation of hostilities; fighting continues regardless.

title: Health and Nutrition In White Nile state, an oral cholera vaccination campaign in February...
description: Health and Nutrition In White Nile state, an oral cholera vaccination campaign in February conducted by the Ministry of Health (MoH) among refugee communities has reduced the rate of cholera outbreaks in the camps.

title: As of 7 April, 498,055 individuals (137,705 households) have been pre-registered (with fin...
description: As of 7 April, 498,055 individuals (137,705 households) have been pre-registered (with fingerprints already captured)/registered (full individual registration in ProGres database and documents issued) since the start of the Sudan emergency.

title: One year of war
description: 8.6 million people displaced - 6.6 million inside Sudan, 1.8 million across borders. Paris conference raises pledges for the humanitarian response.

title: On 29 April, the United States ambassador to the UN, warned that more than 2 million peopl...
description: On 29 April, the United States ambassador to the UN, warned that more than 2 million people in El Fasher, are under imminent threat of a “large-scale massacre” and urged the international community to pressure the two warring parties to scale back.

title: Siege of El Fasher begins
description: Full-scale RSF assault on El Fasher, North Darfur, starts an 18-month siege of the city and its 1.5+ million residents and IDPs.

title: He emphasized the need to respect their right to seek safety and the need for an immediate...
description: He emphasized the need to respect their right to seek safety and the need for an immediate ceasefire.

title: Following refugees' movement out of Awlala and Kumer, partners are facing difficulties in ...
description: Following refugees' movement out of Awlala and Kumer, partners are facing difficulties in providing basic WASH services for those refugees outside the settlements, which increases the chance of diseases such as cholera outbreak.

title: In White Nile State four new cholera cases among the host community were reported in Umrem...
description: In White Nile State four new cholera cases among the host community were reported in Umremta Locality, bringing the total reported cases to over 1,770 since the cholera outbreak in White Nile State in mid-2023.

title: RSF captures Singa, Sennar state
description: The fall of Singa displaces over 700,000 people across Sennar, Blue Nile and Gedaref states.

title: The UN Spokesperson also mentioned that on 11 July, both warring parties were in Switzerla...
description: The UN Spokesperson also mentioned that on 11 July, both warring parties were in Switzerland for UN-led talks aimed at brokering possible local ceasefires to facilitate aid and protect civilians.

title: Famine confirmed in Zamzam camp
description: The IPC Famine Review Committee confirms famine (IPC Phase 5) in Zamzam IDP camp near El Fasher - the first famine determination globally since 2017.

title: They discussed efforts for a ceasefire in Sudan and enhancing humanitarian aid delivery.
description: They discussed efforts for a ceasefire in Sudan and enhancing humanitarian aid delivery.

title: Adre border crossing reopened
description: Sudanese authorities reopen the Adre crossing from Chad for humanitarian convoys into Darfur, initially for three months, later extended.

title: The shortage of fuel and supplies, and related inflation have reduced the purchasing power...
description: The shortage of fuel and supplies, and related inflation have reduced the purchasing power of the vulnerable displaced people who are already impacted by the famine. ▪ The Federal Ministry of Health confirmed the outbreak of cholera in Sudan, with 17 deaths and 268 cases reported in Kassala, Al Gezira, and Khartoum states.

title: Catastrophic flooding
description: Heavy rains and the Arba'at Dam collapse near Port Sudan destroy shelters and cut roads; flooding affects 300,000+ people and worsens cholera outbreaks.

title: Humanitarian partners and authorities are conducting assessments to establish the extent o...
description: Humanitarian partners and authorities are conducting assessments to establish the extent of the damage caused by the dam collapse and address the urgent needs of the affected people.

title: The transit site is congested posing significant public health risks, including a heighten...
description: The transit site is congested posing significant public health risks, including a heightened potential for malaria and cholera outbreaks and other diseases.

title: The President outlined Egypt's efforts to mediate a ceasefire in Sudan and reiterated the ...
description: The President outlined Egypt's efforts to mediate a ceasefire in Sudan and reiterated the country’s dedication to upholding national institutions, sovereignty, and combating terrorism.

title: Now as a result of underfunding, further prioritization and targeting of assistance is bei...
description: Now as a result of underfunding, further prioritization and targeting of assistance is being introduced, leading to tension among the different refugee populations.  On 4 September, Egypt's Ministry of Health and Population (MoHP) increased its alert status and strengthened border controls in response to the cholera outbreak in Sudan.

title: The minister reaffirmed Egypt’s commitment to international obligations and discussed aid ...
description: The minister reaffirmed Egypt’s commitment to international obligations and discussed aid efforts in Sudan, advocating for a ceasefire and improved humanitarian access. ▪ On 22 September, Egypt’s Foreign Minister called for urgent action to resolve the Sudan crisis, stressing the need to stop the violence, secure a ceasefire, and protect resources during a meeting with the Sudanese Foreign Minister at the UNGA.

title: ➢ UNHCR Mpox Appeal 2024 ➢ Press release: Ethiopia’s Refugees and Returnees Service and UN...
description: ➢ UNHCR Mpox Appeal 2024 ➢ Press release: Ethiopia’s Refugees and Returnees Service and UNHCR establish a new site to host Sudanese refugees fleeing unrest. ➢ Briefing Note: New cholera outbreak threatening refugees and displaced communities amid ongoing war and flooding in Sudan ➢ Sudan: Rainy season ushers in severe floods, worsens plight for thousands displaced by war.

title: RSF surge in Aj Jazirah
description: After a senior RSF commander defects to SAF, RSF retaliatory attacks sweep eastern Aj Jazirah villages, driving over 340,000 people toward Gedaref and Kassala.

title: Although the Galabat-Metema border reopened on 22 October, government services like immigr...
description: Although the Galabat-Metema border reopened on 22 October, government services like immigration, visas, and customs have yet to resume due to extensive vandalism that damaged essential equipment.

title: UNHCR, in partnership with health authorities and district surveillance teams, is actively...
description: UNHCR, in partnership with health authorities and district surveillance teams, is actively involved in coordinating response efforts, including implementing screening measures for new arrivals to prevent further spread. ▪ In South Sudan, the Ministry of Health declared a cholera outbreak in Renk, with a total of 79 cases reported, 53 of which have been confirmed.

title: He reaffirmed Egypt’s active role in supporting both regional and international efforts to...
description: He reaffirmed Egypt’s active role in supporting both regional and international efforts to achieve a ceasefire and a peaceful resolution to the conflict.

title: Surge in arrivals to South Sudan
description: Renewed fighting pushes arrival rates at the Joda/Renk border above 1,000 people per day; Renk transit centres exceed capacity many times over.

title: SAF recaptures Wad Madani
description: Sudanese Armed Forces retake Wad Madani; the army begins recovering central Sudan, opening prospects of return to Aj Jazirah.

title: Influx from South Sudan
description: Clashes in Upper Nile state, South Sudan, reverse a flow: by late 2025 over 200,000 people (South Sudanese refugees and returning Sudanese) cross INTO Sudan, mainly to White Nile and Blue Nile states.

title: Cholera outbreaks in White Nile, Gedaref, and South Kordofan pose serious public health ri...
description: Cholera outbreaks in White Nile, Gedaref, and South Kordofan pose serious public health risks, exacerbated by shortages of medical supplies and strained healthcare services. ▪ The Sudan UN RC/HC issued an urgent appeal following funding cuts by key government donors, warning of catastrophic consequences for millions in need.

title: In Zamzam IDP camp, North Darfur State, the withdrawal of NGOs following attacks on the ca...
description: In Zamzam IDP camp, North Darfur State, the withdrawal of NGOs following attacks on the camp has left IDPs without medical services.

title: SAF recaptures Khartoum
description: The army retakes the Presidential Palace (21 March), the airport and most of the capital. Spontaneous returns to Khartoum and Aj Jazirah begin in the following months.

title: RSF assault on Zamzam camp
description: A ground assault on the famine-stricken Zamzam IDP camp kills hundreds and forces 400,000+ people to flee, mostly to Tawila and El Fasher town.

title: Two years of war
description: The crisis marks two years: about 13 million forcibly displaced, including nearly 4 million across borders. London conference seeks renewed funding.

title: The cholera outbreak in Kiryandongo has officially been declared over, following a four-we...
description: The cholera outbreak in Kiryandongo has officially been declared over, following a four-week period with no new suspected or confirmed cases.

title: Drone attacks on Port Sudan
description: Drone strikes hit Port Sudan - the de facto administrative capital and main aid hub - damaging the airport, fuel depots and power stations.

title: In May, Port Sudan and Kassala States witnessed drone attacks on key government and milita...
description: In May, Port Sudan and Kassala States witnessed drone attacks on key government and military infrastructure, the first since the conflict began.

title: Returns gather pace
description: UNHCR begins systematic tracking of returns: hundreds of thousands of Sudanese return from Egypt, South Sudan and Libya toward Khartoum, Aj Jazirah and Sennar, even as Darfur and Kordofan displacement continues.

title: ▪ Chad: The cholera outbreak at Tawila, North Darfur in Sudan has spread into Chad with ca...
description: ▪ Chad: The cholera outbreak at Tawila, North Darfur in Sudan has spread into Chad with cases confirmed in UNHCR’s operational area in Ouaddaï Province, with the first case on 13 July 2025.

title: The cholera outbreak continues to spread across the Darfur and Kordofan regions.
description: The cholera outbreak continues to spread across the Darfur and Kordofan regions.

title: Awareness-raising sessions on child protection, child hygiene, referral pathways, as well ...
description: Awareness-raising sessions on child protection, child hygiene, referral pathways, as well as prevention measures for the cholera outbreak reached 1,420 refugees and IDPs.

title: Highlights  As of 30 October, Chad had reported 2,807 cases and 157 deaths since the begi...
description: Highlights  As of 30 October, Chad had reported 2,807 cases and 157 deaths since the beginning of the cholera outbreak, with several areas in the provinces of Sila and Ouaddaï remaining the most affected.

title: Fall of El Fasher
description: After an 18-month siege, RSF captures El Fasher. Reports of mass atrocities; tens of thousands flee on foot to Tawila amid reports of killings along escape routes.

title: Kordofan offensives intensify
description: Fighting shifts to North and West Kordofan (Bara, Babanusa, El Obeid axis), driving fresh displacement while returns continue to Khartoum and central Sudan.
